verdict.rationale: Auth0 is an API-driven identity platform, so versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask. The evidence pack does not document either. The only mention of versioning concerns Actions code (versioned Node.js functions), not the platform's APIs. The Rules/Hooks-to-Actions upgrade page is marketing, not a published deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.
